name: Zuck Exodus
hook: Flee California before Sacramento garnishes 5% of your sunscreen stockpile
tagline: Steer a solar-powered e-foil loaded with servers, VR goggles, and wagyu cattle away from Silicon Valley as state tax auditors give chase in kayaks. Cash out to hop the Nevada border into a zero-tax bunker. Crash and the Golden Gate bridge tolls snap your paddle while state taxmen impound your hydrofoil.
